1First-hand smoke

The smoker breathes the smoke into his lungs.一手菸：吸菸的人直接把煙吸進肺裡。
☝️ 1 finger → touch your mouth

2Second-hand smoke

Other people breathe the smoke.二手菸：吸菸者吐出來的煙，別人吸到了。
✌️ 2 fingers → touch your nose

3Third-hand smoke

The smoke is gone, but bad stuff stays on things.三手菸：菸熄了，髒東西還留在東西上。
🤟 3 fingers → touch the table

✌️ 2nd-hand
🤟 3rd-hand

What's inside a cigarette? 🔍 菸裡有什麼？

nicotine 尼古丁
makes you want more and more 🔁會讓人上癮，越吸越想吸
tar 焦油
yellow & sticky — makes teeth yellow 🦷黃色黏黏的，會讓牙齒變黃
carbon monoxide 一氧化碳
less oxygen for your body 😮‍💨讓身體得到的氧氣變少

⚠️ Key word: cancer

Smoking can cause cancer.

吸菸可能會導致癌症。
🤒 Cancer is a very serious sickness.
癌症是一種很嚴重的病。
🧪 A cigarette has more than 7,000 chemicals. Some can cause cancer.
一根菸有超過7,000種化學物質，有些會導致癌症。
🫁 lung cancer  ·  👄 mouth cancer
肺癌 · 口腔癌
